purpose: Declarative English conversion choices for the assigned packet; this file contains no executable expressions.

poolPolicy.structuralControls: not authored because this assignment converts evidence and makes no generic repair

profilePolicy.core-only: Tasks solvable from supplied content, language operations, or deterministic generic operations

translationTaskAdaptation.policy: Represent every bilingual pair as Romanian-to-English so the reference answer is English.
translationTaskAdaptation.romanianInput: Retained as task data but transliterated to ASCII because the required validator rejects Romanian diacritics in prompts.
translationTaskAdaptation.originalEnglishToRomanianRows: Direction is reversed using the source reference as input and the source English sentence as answer.
translationTaskAdaptation.disclosure: Each affected case carries a material conversion note; no row is described as a direct translation.

normalizationPolicy.numberFormatting: Semantic values are preserved; English thousands separators and singular/plural agreement may be normalized.
normalizationPolicy.properNames: Standard English exonyms are used where conventional.
normalizationPolicy.sourceDigests: Every exact source-record digest and locator is preserved unchanged.
